あらすじ

This antisocial phimosis-and-balls futanari got bored of jacking off and decided to embark on the path of the exhibitionist! Our girl’s got no charm point whatsoever, but she does have a foul mouth, huge areolas and a tiny dick! Wear and strip whatever clothes you want using the sprite-based exhibitionism system, and track down 12 unique eroscenes!
